name: Nature View as Multi-Channel Prediction Confirmation and Attention Restoration

mechanism_chain.description: A window view of nature simultaneously engages five partially independent channels: (1) T1 fractal fluency — natural scene 1/f statistics engage efficient V1 coding; (2) SC2 prospect — view extends isovist horizon; (3) T25 ART soft fascination — gently interesting natural elements engage involuntary attention, releasing directed attention; (4) L5 temporal variation — natural dynamism provides moderate sustained PE at ~0.1–0.5 Hz; (5) T5 ecological safety — vegetation + spatial depth signal evolutionary safety, reducing amygdala threat monitoring.

data.finding: Hospital patients with tree views had shorter stays (7.96 vs 8.70 days), fewer analgesic doses, and fewer negative nurse evaluations than those with brick wall views
Nature scenes produce faster and more complete stress recovery (GSR, HR, muscle tension) compared to urban scenes within 4-7 minutes
data.effect: Significant GSR and HR recovery advantage for nature by 4-7 min
data.design: Between-subjects (nature vs. urban scenes) after stress induction

data.finding: Spending ≥120 minutes per week in nature associated with good health and wellbeing
data.effect: OR ≈ 1.6 for good health above 120 min/week threshold

justification.backing: VIEW1 has the strongest empirical grounding of any template in the CMR system. The five-channel model (fractal fluency, prospect, ART soft fascination, temporal variation, ecological safety) was accepted by the panel as convergent pathways to stress reduction. Ulrich argued (and the panel agreed) that the aggregate effect (r ≈ 0.55 for nature vs. no-nature view on stress outcomes) is well-established even though the individual channel contributions are less certain.
justification.qualifier: Confidence 0.70 reflects the strongest empirical evidence in this panel. The five channels engage simultaneously and provide redundancy: if one channel is blocked (cloudy day reduces fractal fluency), others remain active. The inter-channel correlation (r ≈ 0.30, panel estimate) means channels are partially redundant but not identical. The convergence coefficient was rejected as a single number; instead, channel contributions sum with partial redundancy correction.
justification.rebuttal: Ulrich (panel debate) argued against two theoretical moves: (a) full absorption into PE framework — his SRT predicts the effect is AUTOMATIC and INVOLUNTARY, not requiring prediction error computation; degraded, low-resolution nature images still produce benefit; (b) the convergence coefficient as a measured quantity — the five channels have not been independently varied in a within-subjects design.

competing_accounts.claim: Nature view benefit is an automatic evolutionary response to ecological safety cues, not mediated by prediction error reduction — the effect occurs even for degraded, low-resolution nature images
competing_accounts.implication_for_template: If SRT rather than PE, the mechanism is subcortical and automatic rather than cortical/computational. The practical prediction is identical but the mechanistic account differs. SRT predicts benefit from any nature cue regardless of fractal quality; PE predicts benefit scaled to fractal coding efficiency.

mechanism_chain.description: Convergent confirmation across channels reduces overall allostatic PE → promotes parasympathetic activation (vagal tone increase), cortisol reduction, heart rate reduction. Ulrich (1984): hospital patients with tree views: 7.96 vs. 8.70 day stay. Ulrich et al. (1991): 4–7 minute GSR recovery vs. urban scenes.

data.finding: Hospital patients with nature views had shorter stays and fewer analgesic doses
GSR and HR recovery significantly faster for nature vs. urban scenes within 4-7 minutes of stress induction
data.effect: Significant autonomic recovery advantage by 4-7 min

data.finding: Meta-analysis of nature exposure studies confirms significant positive effects on cortisol, blood pressure, and heart rate
data.effect: Significant pooled effects across physiological stress markers
data.design: Meta-analysis of field and laboratory studies

justification.backing: The autonomic stress reduction effect has the strongest replication record in environmental psychology. Ulrich's 1984 study (~7,000 citations) established the effect; Ulrich et al. 1991 confirmed the physiological pathway; Bowler's meta-analysis confirmed cross-study robustness. The mechanism through parasympathetic activation (vagal tone increase) and cortisol reduction is convergently supported.
justification.qualifier: Confidence 0.75 is the highest in this template and among the highest in the CMR system. This reflects the combination of a landmark quasi-experimental study (Ulrich 1984), multiple physiological replications, and meta-analytic confirmation. The qualifier is that most studies cannot fully control for confounds (nature views also provide more daylight, better air quality in some cases).
justification.rebuttal: The claim would fail if: (a) the nature view benefit is primarily driven by daylight exposure (L1/circadian pathway) rather than view content per se — controlling for lux level would eliminate the effect; (b) the hospital recovery effect is specific to post-surgical patients and does not generalize to healthy occupants in non-clinical settings.

mechanism_chain.description: Channel 3 (ART): involuntary attention engagement → TPN deactivation → DMN re-engagement → directed attention resource replenishment (Kaplan, 1995). Duration required: ~5 min for initial DMN re-engagement; ~20–40 min for full restoration. This is resource recovery during involuntary engagement, not metabolic efficiency of nature processing per se.

data.finding: Natural environments restore directed attention capacity through involuntary ("soft") fascination
data.effect: Restoration requires ~5 min initiation, ~20-40 min for full effect
data.design: Theoretical framework with supporting behavioral studies

data.finding: Breast cancer patients with nature exposure showed improved directed attention capacity
data.effect: Significant improvement in directed attention tasks with nature exposure

justification.backing: Kaplan's ART mechanism — that directed attention is a finite, depletable resource recovered through involuntary fascination — provides a distinct contribution to the VIEW1 effect beyond Ulrich's stress reduction. The mechanism operates through TPN deactivation → DMN re-engagement → directed attention replenishment. This is resource recovery, not metabolic efficiency. Kaplan (panel debate) insisted on this distinction: PE efficiency would predict longer exposure always helps; ART predicts non-monotonic time function with 5-min initiation threshold.
justification.qualifier: Confidence 0.60 with MECHANISM warrant reflects that the ART pathway is well-motivated theoretically and has some clinical support (Cimprich) but the specific neural mechanism (DMN re-engagement during soft fascination) is inferred rather than directly measured. The 5-min threshold and 20-40 min plateau are estimates from behavioral studies, not from neural measurement.
justification.rebuttal: The claim would fail if: (a) directed attention restoration occurs through any form of mental rest, not specifically nature-triggered soft fascination — in which case meditation or quiet rooms would be equally effective without nature content; (b) the DMN re-engagement hypothesis is incorrect and the benefit operates through a different neural pathway (e.g., default mode suppression rather than activation).

name: "Nature View as Multi-Channel Prediction Confirmation — How Visual Access to Natural Environments Produces Convergent Stress Reduction, Attention Restoration, and Positive Affect"

structural_pattern: >
  A window view of nature engages multiple PE mechanisms
  simultaneously, producing a convergent effect that exceeds
  the sum of individual channels. This structural parallel to
  L3 (daylight convergence) and MAT4 (wood convergence) is the
  template's central insight: nature views are powerful not
  because of any single mechanism but because they confirm
  predictions across MANY channels at once.
  
  FIVE CONVERGENT CHANNELS:
  
  CHANNEL 1 — FRACTAL FLUENCY (T1): Natural scenes exhibit
  1/f spatial frequency profiles with fractal dimension near
  D ≈ 1.3 (Taylor et al., 2011). This matches the visual
  system's processing structure, producing maximal processing
  fluency and minimal visual PE. Trees, clouds, water surfaces,
  and terrain all exhibit fractal statistics. Built environments
  typically exhibit non-fractal statistics (regular geometry,
  flat surfaces, periodic repetition). The nature view confirms
  the visual system's deep prediction for natural spatial
  statistics.
  
  CHANNEL 2 — PROSPECT AND SPATIAL DEPTH (SC2/T5): Nature
  views typically provide spatial depth (long isovist) with
  vegetative partial enclosure — the prospect-refuge combination
  that Appleton (1975) identified and SC2 formalizes. The
  ability to see far (prospect) with the protection of an
  enclosed space (refuge through the building itself) confirms
  the spatial prediction for safety: the occupant can monitor
  the environment for threats and opportunities while being
  protected. A view of a brick wall provides neither prospect
  nor spatial depth.
  
  CHANNEL 3 — ATTENTION RESTORATION (T25/ART): Natural scenes
  engage "soft fascination" — involuntary attention to gently
  interesting stimuli (moving leaves, drifting clouds, flowing
  water) that permits directed attention to rest and recover
  (Kaplan, 1995). This is the attentional Goldilocks zone:
  enough engagement to prevent disengagement, insufficient
  demand to deplete directed attention. A blank wall provides
  no fascination; a busy urban scene provides hard fascination
  that demands effortful processing.
  
  CHANNEL 4 — TEMPORAL VARIATION (L5): Nature views are
  inherently dynamic: wind moves branches, clouds shift,
  light changes, seasons transform the scene. This dynamic
  variation provides the temporal PE that L5 formalizes —
  gradual, natural change that maintains interest without
  producing surprise. The view of nature is a built-in
  dynamic light and pattern display that changes continuously
  through the day and across seasons.
  
  CHANNEL 5 — ECOLOGICAL SAFETY SIGNAL: Green vegetation,
  water, and spatial openness are evolutionary signals of
  a resource-rich, safe environment (Ulrich et al., 1991).
  This is the biophilia/SRT mechanism: the presence of
  nature signals environmental safety, reducing HPA axis
  activation (T5) and contributing to allostatic balance
  (T29). Built environments lack this signal; degraded
  environments (dead vegetation, polluted water) may
  invert it.
  
  CONVERGENCE: Each channel contributes a modest individual
  effect. The convergent total — all five channels confirming
  predictions simultaneously — produces a strong, multi-
  mechanism benefit that explains why nature views consistently
  produce measurable health outcomes (Ulrich, 1984; White
  et al., 2019) while individual mechanisms produce smaller
  effects in isolation. The structural parallel to L3 and
  MAT4 is deliberate: MULTI-CHANNEL CONVERGENCE IS A GENERAL
  PRINCIPLE of how natural stimuli produce strong effects.

cross_template_interactions.IC2_body_budget: VIEW1 is the single largest documented reducer of architectural allostatic load. Multi-channel nature view simultaneously addresses visual PE cost (T1), threat monitoring cost (T5), attentional fatigue cost (T25), and spatial prediction cost (SC2). Buildings providing high-quality nature views reduce IC2 body-budget expenditure substantially.
cross_template_interactions.AX4_perceived_control: Nature views provide a strong AX4 signal when occupants can CHOOSE to look out (operable windows, movable workstations near windows). The AX4 contribution to the total VIEW1 benefit is significant when control is present; Ulrich's controlled study documents the bare nature-view benefit without AX4.

luminance_level.description: Minimum useful: >0.5m² for seated occupant at 3m. Benefit scales ~log(window_area); diminishing returns above 3m² per occupant.

glazing_type.description: Clear glass preserves all channels. Tinted: −20% effect. Frosted: −80% effect.

nature_view_quality.description: Close nature (<5m): maximum T1 + T5. Distance >50m: reduced T1 + T5, maintained SC2 prospect.
